Method of Attack: Encrypts files on a computer, scrambles file names, and appends the BlackRuby extension
Installs a Monero miner that utilizes maximum CPU resources
Terminates sql.exe process and deletes shadow copies and event logs
Renames encrypted files to format Encrypted_[scrambled_file_name].BlackRuby
Drops ransom note HOW-TO-DECRYPT-FILES.txt demanding $650 USD in bitcoin
Checks victim's IP via http://freegeoip.net/json/ and does not run if victim is from Iran
